verdict.rationale: The evidence shows vLLM manages KV-cache memory automatically through PagedAttention, prefix caching and continuous batching. Nothing in the pack documents a user-facing control for allocating context or KV memory, such as a memory-fraction setting, and nothing covers running multiple model instances concurrently on shared hardware. Automatic memory efficiency is an adjacent feature rather than the user control the story asks for, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
